rationale: The plan identifies the design correctly and uses exactly the right test: a DESeq2 LRT of ~condition + time + condition:time against ~condition + time, with per-time-point Wald simple effects and trajectory clustering to describe the significant genes, plus an honest statement of the low power of a difference-of-differences at n=3 per cell. QC (blind VST, PCA on top 500 variable genes colored by condition and time, library sizes, sample-distance heatmap) precedes modelling with an explicit rule for naming outliers, though the downstream action if one is found is left implicit. Filtering (>=10 counts in >=3 samples, the smallest cell) is minimal and justified, normalization stays inside the model with VST reserved for exploration, reference levels and both model formulas are stated, and BH at alpha=0.05 with independent filtering, apeglm shrinkage for reporting, and a p-value histogram are all specified correctly. Enrichment was not requested by the question but is added and executed rigorously (full ranked list by LRT statistic, named collections with versions, 15-500 size window, tested-gene universe, ORA gated on list size), which is defensible but slightly beyond scope. Reporting is thorough: versions, design, contrasts, thresholds, tested/significant counts, seeds, sessionInfo, and the design caveat repeated; only the muddled 24-vs-25 sample statement detracts.
